text_block_list.text:
One day, as her debut race drew near, 
Shinko Windy said:

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Minion! I've come up with a 
plan to make a huge, flashy splash in my 
debut race!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As you know... dirt races don't really get 
that much attention, do they?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan... The other day you said, 
"I'll stand out more than the turf!", but 
just trying hard isn't gonna cut it.
choice_data_list: I see, you’ve got a point there.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Right? That's why, before they look at 
Windy-chan, I think we should get them to 
notice the dirt track first!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
For that sake... We're gonna shoot a movie 
with "Dirt" as the theme!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've already written the script! Starring 
and directed by Windy-chan! You've got a 
role too! Go on, read it!

Depicted there... was a grand spectacle 
completely disregarding budget, 
technology, and manpower. No matter how 
you looked at it, pulling it off would be 
nearly impossible. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"How about that~? If we show this in 
theaters, it'll be a massive hit and kick 
off a whole dirt racing boom~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-It's no good...?! Come on, it's super 
hilarious, isn't it?!

"Naturally, a theatrical release is 
impossible. How can I steer things without 
throwing cold water on their hard-earned 
enthusiasm...?"
choice_data_list: That's it, if it's a short "PV"...!

text_block_list.text:
"Since making a full movie seemed 
difficult, I suggested shooting a 
promotional video instead. It fits our 
goal of promoting dirt racing, too."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yeah, yeah... I see...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...You're pretty good! As expected of 
Windy-chan's chosen minion— or rather—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —As expected of an "evil mastermind"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right! Strategy meeting adjourned! 
Let's get right to it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The storyboards are totally 
spot-on! And then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's location scouting, nanoda~! Great 
shot, nanoda! Windy-chan is a pure genius, 
nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what else do we need~? An editing 
app~, some BGM~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Then I'll leave that part to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ghehe~, going smoothly. You're doing 
pretty well yourself!"

In truth, she had done almost all the 
work. I had really only lent a minor hand. 
Once again, I was struck by her drive...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll draw a scene with a ton of 
background characters running... Hmm...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Windy-san? Heyyy, what are you taking 
pictures of?

The ones who appeared were dirt Umamusume, 
seemingly in the middle of training.

Smart Falcon aims to be a sparkling 
Umamusume idol, an "Umadol." And then...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wawa... Without asking...! As a local 
idol, having photos snapped right when I'm 
all sweaty is a bit much.

Hokko Tarumae, a local idol Umamusume who 
loves her hometown of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Since we're here, wanna strike a 
cute pose?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Enough of that. You lot, go run a bit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what is it, what is it? What do you 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen and be amazed~! Windy-chan is gonna 
make a promotional video to make dirt 
tracks popular!
A promotional video to make dirt popular?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rickey and Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean "attracting more 
customers"? Then it's time for Feng Shui 
power! The Feng Shui used for shops should 
work for videos too☆

Her name is Copano Rickey. An Umamusume 
determined to bring everyone happiness and 
good luck through feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's a... "PV"? Will it bring more 
spectators to the dirt tracks?

"And the other is... Gentle, caring, and 
possessing an indomitable spirit, the 
consummate veteran Umamusume: Wonder 
Acute."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. I shall explain 
everything to you all from square one. You 
see—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Windy-san, you're doing your best 
for the sake of dirt tracks!? I'm so 
happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You certainly take initiative. All the 
dirt runners will definitely be thrilled 
with this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you've been writing 
so diligently lately. Maybe I should lend 
a hand too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! A roaring business☆ Everyone's 
happy! Let's hype up the dirt races!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho...! They understand how things work, 
nod-nod.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right! We're gonna make something 
amazing together! And then broadcast it on 
the giant street screens!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A public billboard screen? Hmm, I wonder 
about that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san, putting up an advertisement in 
a place like that costs an astronomical 
amount of money.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What!? Th-Th-Th-That's... I already knew 
that! I was just saying it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then... Then............ What am I 
supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, no problem☆ There are other 
ways to do it. Why don't we just use 
Umastagram for now?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it'd be great if we can get it to go 
viral. To start, let's have everyone in 
the dirt division share it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I, see...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hae~, so that's how you're spreading the 
word. I reckon I thought you'd put it on 
the academy's "homepage" or somethin' 
instead...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that might actually work... Having 
an "official" title carries a lot of 
weight!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, people might find it 
hilarious like, 'Wait, this is official?' 
Plus, since students made it, they might 
cut us some slack on the quality..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! You guys are coming one after 
another...! What wonderful minions you 
are~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, ooh! I've got a feeling this is gonna 
be a huge success, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna head over to the Student Council 
Room and 'gotiate with them right away!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you're certainly full of energy. 
Must be thrilled that your debut's been 
decided, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's leaning towards the Yang energy... 
yeah, that's fine for now. I can feel a 
new flow of Qi pouring into the dirt 
world...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was a bit worried since she was always 
pulling pranks, but it really feels like 
she's 'finally gotten serious.'

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it kind of makes me happy. I can't 
help but watch someone working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Our debut is still a ways off, but... we 
definitely want to cheer on the girls 
debuting before us, right?♪"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum♪ Oho, this is the place! 
Coming in~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Coming in without knocking...? I'm 
pretty sure all the Student Council 
members had off-campus duties today...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Suspicious...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dammit, there's nobody here...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Toh! Windy-senpai! What are you doing over 
there!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're not allowed to barge in when no 
student council members are here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it's just you, Biko. Noisy as 
always, I see.

She is Biko Pegasus. A high-spirited 
Umamusume who idolizes the hero of 
justice, Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't you dare get in the way of 
Windy-chan's grand scheme, nodda...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A grand plan...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...! Prepare to be amazed...! 
The reason Windy-chan came here is...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is just preparation to plunge the 
racing world into the depths of 
terror~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? How could anyone do something 
so awful...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I thought you were just always pulling 
pranks, Senpai... Are you... actually a 
really bad person after all!?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Windy-chan is bad to the bone~! The 
baddest of the bad-noda!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Are you... an evil Umamusume...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to fight, but... as an 
Umamusume of justice, I cannot overlook 
this!

"—Passing by the student council room, I 
noticed a commotion inside. Wait, that 
voice belongs to...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaah! You're so persistent! If that's 
how it is, let's settle this with a race 
on the track! I'm gonna leave you in the 
dust!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"All right! Challenge accepted! When I 
win, you have to stop doing bad things!"

I rushed in to mediate and brought the 
situation under control. It seemed the 
misunderstanding was cleared up (?), 
but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still... isn't Windy-senpai trying to be a 
'bad girl'?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Then... I just can't help but be curious!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
For the peace of the academy, I'll be 
keeping my eyes on Windy-senpai at all 
times...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Farewell! Until we meet again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Did you hear that? They're saying 
that person can't take their eyes off 
Windy-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh...! Looks like everyone's paying 
attention to Windy-chan's villainous 
side...!

Biko Pegasus... She's an Umamusume worth 
keeping an eye on. She might just end up 
clashing with Shinko Windy on the track 
one of these days...!
